en: What's wrong with me?
Hans, a woman? No, there's no way
that's possible.
Aaah!
note: trailing space: always followed on the same line by #644 or #650

en: I've been out of it since this morning!
I'm Heinrich, a navy soldier.
I'm heading back to the barracks from warehouse watch.
Looking to enlist, are you?
Then you'd better speak with Commander
Thomas about it.
I'm losing my mind!
This is the navy barracks.
Need something?
note: shared with Hans (msgs 230117, 230303, 230943): reads fine for both

en: I can't let a civilian in without
the commander's permission.
We keep running into each other, you and me.
Still, that Hans...
Argh, it's bugging me.
You're not looking to enlist, so why
are you here?
Don't tell me you're also curious
note: 'Hans' moved to #661/#728 so the shared row works with both

en: about Hans?
Argh, I'm dying to know!
Hey, civilians can't just walk in here.
This is the navy armory.
My job right now is to watch the armory.
If you want to enlist,
you have to go to headquarters.
You shouldn't hang around here too long.
They might mistake you for a spy.
I share this post with a mercenary
note: 'a guy called Hans' recast as 'a mercenary named Hans' to avoid a gendered pronoun later

en: named Hans, who takes the other shifts.
Have you ever met Hans?
<I've met Hans>
<I haven't met Hans>
What do you think of Hans?
Hans is a crack mercenary with war merits,
but with that look,
and so slender, on top of that...
I've never seen Hans out of uniform,
not once. Could it be...
No, surely not.
I see. If you don't know, never mind.
Oh, it's you.
Come to think of it, I found a ring here.
Lately, the only people around here
have been me, Hans, and you. Just us three.
Any idea whose it is?
As a matter of fact,
note: player's reply; #688 + pause + #689 on one line

en: I do.
note: leading space: joins #688 on the same line after a pause token (1A 05). Christopher version #730 should also be ' I do.'

en: Allow me to hold on to it.
So it was yours after all?
Well, well, you handsome rascal.
I asked Hans too, just in case,
but all I got was a 'no idea'...
(Received the 'Jade Ring'.)
Standing guard all day is boring,
but it's a proper duty, too.
The other day, near the barracks, I saw a
tall beauty.
And she looked like Hans, I swear.
I've got to shake off these distractions...
Work, work... Right.
You
What are you doing in a place like this?
note: leading space: follows #2 '...' on the same line

en: Am I half asleep...?
I'll tell you something good.
You've wondered about Hans, haven't you?
Just as you suspected, that one is a woman.
What! Surely...
No, I knew it...
This is nuts! If it's a dream, wake me up!
Besides,
Hey, what are you doing?
Since you're at it, why not propose to her?
Though that woman is already in my hands.
Ha ha ha, what a shame.
It's no dream.
But from today you'll be a sleepwalker,
roaming the streets at night.
